source: synthetic: concatenated deceptive trap-5 functions with bits scattered at random
analysis_unit: binary string of m traps x 5 bits (m in 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16)
success_criterion: optimum found in at least 90% of the seeds
ground_truth: the true traps of each instance, used only to score DAMICORE's groups
metrics: success rate per problem and population size
smallest population that solves each problem size
evaluations until the optimum and their log-log scaling exponent
adjusted Rand index between DAMICORE's groups and the true traps, per generation
traps returned exactly as one group
damicore_roles: variable groups over the promising strings of each generation
